Control Title: Joiner-mover-leaver for core and network IDs
Control Description: New core-banking, FedLine, and Active Directory IDs are requested through the access ticket, approved by the employee's manager and the application owner, and provisioned by IT Operations. Movers are recertified within five business days of the role change. Leavers are disabled the same day HR marks the last day.

Control Title: Quarterly recertification of privileged core IDs
Control Description: Application owners recertify every privileged ID on the core, SWIFT gateway, and domain admin groups each calendar quarter. IDs not recertified by the due date are disabled by IT Operations the next business day.

Control Title: Segregation of duties: note origination vs GL posting
Control Description: No user may both originate a commercial note in the core and post the related general-ledger entry. The SOD matrix is reviewed when roles change and at least annually. Exceptions require CFO written approval and a compensating review.

Control Title: Privileged access on FedLine and core is named and logged
Control Description: Shared or generic administrator IDs are prohibited on FedLine, the core, and the wire room workstation. Each privileged session is logged and reviewed weekly by Information Security.

Control Title: Lockout after failed logons on employee SSO and digital banking admin
Control Description: Employee SSO and the digital-banking administration console lock an ID after five consecutive failed logons. Unlock requires a service desk ticket and manager confirmation.

Control Title: MFA for remote access and privileged core sessions
Control Description: Remote VPN, cloud admin, and any privileged core session require phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication. Emergency break-glass IDs are stored with dual control and logged.

Control Title: Authenticator issuance and reset
Control Description: Hardware tokens and password resets for core and FedLine are issued only after in-person or video identity verification against HR records. Default passwords are changed before the ID is activated.

Control Title: Security and core application logging enabled
Control Description: Logon, privileged commands, and parameter changes on the core, Active Directory, and firewalls are logged and retained for 18 months. Logging cannot be disabled without a change ticket.

Control Title: Weekly SIEM review of privileged and failed-access events
Control Description: Information Security reviews the SIEM dashboard of privileged use and failed access each week, documents the review, and opens an incident ticket for unexplained activity within one business day.

Control Title: Production changes to core and interfaces require a ticket
Control Description: Every production change to the core, ACH/wire interfaces, and general ledger feed requires a change ticket, test evidence, and approval by IT Operations and the application owner before migration. Emergency changes are retro-approved within two business days.

Control Title: Hardening baselines for servers that host the core
Control Description: Servers that host the core and its database are built from a documented hardening baseline. Deviations are tracked as exceptions with an expiration date and compensating control.

Control Title: Baseline inventory of in-scope SOX applications
Control Description: The SOX PMO maintains an inventory of in-scope applications, data flows, and owners. Additions and retirements are approved in the quarterly scoping meeting.

Control Title: Contingency plan for core deposit processing
Control Description: The bank maintains a documented contingency plan covering core deposit processing, ATM/debit authorization, and FedLine. Recovery time for deposit posting is 4 hours; recovery point is the last successful batch.

Control Title: Annual disaster-recovery test of core processing
Control Description: IT Operations and Business Continuity run an annual disaster-recovery test that fails the core to the alternate site, posts a sample deposit file, and records actual recovery time against the 4-hour objective. Exceptions are logged as issues.

Control Title: Nightly backup of core and general ledger
Control Description: Nightly backups of the core database and the general ledger are completed, verified by a restore-sample monthly, and stored offsite. Failed backups page IT Operations before 7 a.m.

Control Title: Computer-room badge access and visitor log
Control Description: The computer room is restricted by badge. Access lists are recertified quarterly by Facilities and IT Operations. Visitors are escorted and logged. Terminated employees' badges are collected the last day.

Control Title: Malware and IDS alerting on bank workstations and servers
Control Description: Endpoint malware protection and network IDS cover all bank workstations and servers. Alerts are triaged by Information Security within four hours during business days.

Control Title: Quarterly vulnerability scanning of in-scope infrastructure
Control Description: In-scope servers and network devices are scanned at least quarterly. Critical findings are patched or formally accepted within 30 days; high findings within 90 days.

Control Title: Encryption in transit for ACH, wire, and core-processor files
Control Description: ACH, wire, and core-processor files leaving the bank are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2 or higher). Plaintext FTP is prohibited.

Control Title: Encryption at rest for core database backups
Control Description: Core database backups are encrypted at rest with keys held in the bank's key-management process, split from the backup operators.

Control Title: Oversight of the core processor and material fintechs
Control Description: Vendor Management reviews SOC reports, financials, and concentration risk for the core processor and material fintechs at least annually, with findings reported to the steering committee.

Control Title: Security incident handling and regulatory notification
Control Description: Confirmed security incidents are handled under the incident plan. Notification to the primary federal regulator and, when required, to customers follows the bank's incident-notification matrix.

Control Title: Same-day collection of tokens and badges on termination
Control Description: On an employee's last day, HR notifies IT Operations and Facilities. Hardware tokens, VPN certificates, and badges are collected or revoked the same day, and a termination checklist is filed.

Control Title: Daily proof of DDA subsidiary to the general ledger
Control Description: Deposit Operations completes a daily proof of the demand-deposit subsidiary to the general-ledger DDA control account before 10 a.m. Differences above $500 are aged, assigned an owner, and cleared within two business days. Unresolved items are reported to the Controller.

Control Title: Monthly balance-sheet account reconciliations
Control Description: Each on-us balance-sheet account in the SOX scope is reconciled to the subsidiary or bank-owned statement by the 10th business day. Reconciliations are reviewed by a second officer who did not prepare them. Aged items over 30 days require Controller sign-off.

Control Title: Period-end close checklist and hold of the books
Control Description: The Controller maintains a close checklist covering subledger roll-forwards, suspense cleanup, and tax provision inputs. The general ledger is held after the checklist is complete. Subsequent entries require dual approval and are listed on the post-close entry log.

Control Title: Manual journal entries require preparer and approver
Control Description: Manual journal entries to SOX-in-scope accounts are prepared by one accountant and approved by a second person with no ability to post the same entry. Supporting calculations are attached in the journal-entry package before posting.

Control Title: Recurring and automatic journal-entry review
Control Description: The SOX PMO reviews the inventory of recurring and system-generated journal entries each quarter for unauthorized changes to amount, account, or schedule. Changes require a ticket and Controller approval.

Control Title: Quarter-end allowance for credit losses sign-off
Control Description: Credit Administration runs the CECL calculation, documents qualitative adjustments, and presents the allowance to the Allowance Committee. The Chief Credit Officer and Controller sign the quarter-end package before the books close.

Control Title: Charge-off approval above officer limit
Control Description: Loan charge-offs above an officer's lending authority are approved by the Chief Credit Officer and reported to the Directors' Loan Committee. Charge-off codes in the core cannot be applied without the approved form.

Control Title: Exception-item and NSF decisioning dual control
Control Description: NSF, stop-pay, and large exception items are decisioned in the core by one officer and released by a second. Officers cannot decision their own accounts. Daily exception totals are balanced to the GL.

Control Title: Accrued interest proof for loans and deposits
Control Description: Accounting proofs accrued interest receivable and payable to the core's accrual reports monthly. Variances over a documented threshold are investigated before the close.

Control Title: Annual management assessment of ICFR
Control Description: Management prepares the Part 363 report on internal control over financial reporting, including identified material weaknesses, and presents it to the Audit Committee before filing. Supporting testing is retained in the SOX workpapers.

Control Title: External-auditor PBC package completeness
Control Description: The SOX PMO assembles the provided-by-client package (trial balance, reconciliations, ICFR testing, legal letters) against a checklist. Missing items are logged and cleared before the auditor's fieldwork start date.

Control Title: Customer identification at account opening
Control Description: New consumers and entities are identified under the CIP procedure before the account is opened on the core. Name, date of birth or formation, address, and identification number are collected, and documentary or non-documentary verification is recorded. CIP exceptions require BSA Officer approval.

Control Title: OFAC screening of customers and payment messages
Control Description: New customers, periodic batch files, and outbound wires/ACH are screened against the OFAC list before the relationship or payment is completed. Potential matches are decisioned by the BSA Officer. True matches are blocked and documented.

Control Title: Currency transaction report filing
Control Description: Currency transactions aggregating over the CTR threshold in a business day are captured from teller and vault activity. CTRs are filed within the FinCEN window. Exemptions are reviewed annually.

Control Title: Suspicious activity decisioning and SAR filing
Control Description: Alerts from monitoring, teller referrals, and law-enforcement requests are decisioned by BSA staff. SARs are filed within the regulatory window when activity is suspicious. The BSA Officer reports SAR volume to the Board without tipping customers.

Control Title: CDD and beneficial-ownership refresh
Control Description: Legal-entity customers provide beneficial-ownership information at opening. Higher-risk relationships are refreshed on a documented cycle. Missing or stale CDD blocks new product booking until cleared.

Control Title: Independent test of the BSA/AML program
Control Description: Internal Audit or a qualified independent party tests the BSA/AML program at least annually, covering CIP, OFAC, monitoring, and training. Findings are reported to the Audit Committee.

Control Title: Dual control on wire initiation and release
Control Description: Wires above the documented callback threshold are entered by one employee and released by a second using separate FedLine credentials. Token holders cannot hold both roles on the same payment. A daily funds-transfer log is balanced to FedLine.

Control Title: Out-of-band callback on customer wire instructions
Control Description: Customer wire instructions received by email or online banking are confirmed by a recorded callback to a phone number on file, not a number in the request. Callbacks are documented on the wire ticket before release.

Control Title: ACH file origination dual control
Control Description: Originated ACH files are generated from approved source files, balanced to the batch recap, and released by a second officer. Same-day ACH after the cutoff requires supervisor approval.

Control Title: Unauthorized ACH return handling
Control Description: Customer claims of unauthorized ACH are logged, returned within NACHA windows, and reviewed for patterns. Repeat originators are referred to BSA.

Control Title: Loan approval within documented authority
Control Description: Loan decisions are approved by officers within the Board-approved authority matrix. Policy exceptions are listed on the exception report and ratified by the Directors' Loan Committee.

Control Title: Collateral exception tracking
Control Description: Missing or expired collateral (insurance, UCC, appraisal) is tracked on an exception list. Past-due items are reported to the Chief Credit Officer monthly until cured or waived.

Control Title: Material fourth-party and concentration review
Control Description: Vendor Management inventories fourth parties used by the core processor and material fintechs and reviews concentration risk at least annually. Findings go to the steering committee with the SOC-report review.

Control Title: Annual security awareness for employees with system access
Control Description: Employees with core, FedLine, or email access complete annual security-awareness training, including phishing recognition. New hires complete training within 30 days. Completions are reported to Information Security.

Control Title: Patch management for in-scope servers
Control Description: In-scope servers are patched on a documented cycle: critical security patches within 30 days of release unless a formal exception is open. Failed patches are re-queued and reported to the CISO.

Control Title: Sanitization of disks and media before reuse or vendor return
Control Description: Hard drives, tapes, and teller-equipment storage leaving the bank are wiped or destroyed under a documented procedure. Certificates of destruction are filed by Facilities.

Control Title: Annual information-security program report to the Board
Control Description: The CISO presents the information-security program, including significant incidents, vendor issues, and resource needs, to the Board or a designated committee at least annually.

Control Title: Monthly control-monitoring dashboard to the CISO
Control Description: Information Security produces a monthly dashboard of failed logons, privileged use, patch exceptions, and open issues for in-scope systems. The CISO reviews and initials the dashboard.

Control Title: Core-processor change and subcontracting notice
Control Description: Material changes to the core processor's environment or subcontractors are reviewed by Vendor Management and IT Operations before acceptance. Unreviewed changes are logged as issues.

Control Title: Customer information used only for authorized bank purposes
Control Description: Customer nonpublic information is used only for the product or service the customer requested, or as permitted by the privacy notice. Extracts for vendors require a contract and least-privilege access.

Control Title: Synchronized clocks on core, directory, and SIEM
Control Description: Production core, Active Directory, and the SIEM synchronize to an authenticated time source. Drift beyond a documented threshold pages IT Operations.

Control Title: Unused services disabled on servers that host the core
Control Description: Servers that host the core and its database run only required services. Newly enabled services require a change ticket. Quarterly scans report unexpected listeners.

Control Title: Dual control over encryption keys for core backups
Control Description: Keys that encrypt core-database backups are generated and stored under dual control, split from backup operators. Key-ceremony logs are retained with the information-security program.

Control Title: Annual incident-response tabletop
Control Description: Information Security runs an annual tabletop covering a core outage or customer-data event, including regulator-notification timing. Lessons learned become issues with owners and due dates.

Control Title: Alternate-site contract and annual walkthrough
Control Description: The bank maintains a contracted alternate processing site capable of deposit posting. Business Continuity walks the site annually and confirms network, badge, and core-image readiness against the 4-hour recovery objective.

Control Title: After-hours computer-room access review
Control Description: Facilities reviews after-hours badge events for the computer room each month. Unexplained access is referred to Information Security within two business days.

Control Title: Email gateway filtering for bank mail
Control Description: Inbound and outbound bank email passes through a gateway that blocks known malware and obvious phishing. Quarantine releases require Information Security approval.

Control Title: Independent external network test of internet-facing systems
Control Description: An independent party tests internet-facing systems at least annually. Critical findings are tracked to remediation or formal acceptance by the CISO.
